article.title: Route the Trajectory, Not the Request

data.text:
I built a model router for a coding agent and measured it on 144 SWE-bench runs.
The harness saved more than the router. Three actions that need no model call cut cost per resolved task more than the routing choices I tested. https://t.co/VgybJn5HZU
